task: Scratch implementation of default-off wxGTK3 font-DPI opt-in
count_scope: The one open blocker is inherited WXSOL-001, owned by the parent integration; no candidate seam blocker was found.

findings.novelty: Inherited verified finding, not a new candidate defect.
findings.title: The compatibility gate is supplied, but the app still floats its wx dependency

locations.candidate: wx-opt-in.patch adds the default-off guard at candidate line 4394

findings.trigger: Integrating only the app SetOption, without selecting an exact wx revision containing the gate and both GTK fixes, leaves dependency selection on upstream master.
findings.outcome: The selected dependency is not established by these scratch patches. The opt-in fixes the old-consumer policy only after the wx candidate is actually integrated; source/runtime integration remains unverified.
findings.smallest_practical_fix: Parent integrates this small wx gate on the intended wx base, then pins its exact reachable SHA and correct repository URL in a separate app integration PR stacked on corrected consumers. No old release branch edits are required by this default-off mechanism.
findings.verification_needed: Parent verifies final diff, exact wx ancestry/blobs and declared-repository reachability, then rebuilds wx and Bambu together and checks opted and unopted consumers at GTK3 font DPI 96/144 and GDK scale 1/2. Obtain native OS evidence before any all-OS claims.
findings.blocking_scope: Completing/claiming the reproducible integration; does not mean a flaw was found in the delivered default-off candidate.

limitations: Extracted conversion/wrapper/rounding code and actual sysopt header, with GTK/window/value-object doubles; not a complete wx or Bambu compilation.
Enabled wxSystemOptions lookup is a double; actual string/environment semantics were inspected in frozen source only.
Windows/macOS/GTK2 startup checks are Linux-host macro probes, not native OS builds or runtime tests.
Startup ordering combines source call-site inspection and a simulated inner routine; it is not an exhaustive pre-OnInit runtime trace.
No native GTK rendering, full options-disabled build, shared-library/ABI check or merge-readiness approval.
No source repository/index/ref/application/GUI/profile/printer changes, project builds, delegation or publication.
